messages.subject: Fitted versus Observed
parts:
Hi,

I want to plot "Fitted versus Observed" but I can't find how to extract the expected values of the posterior predictive distributions from the fitted INLA model to plot that and calculate R squared.  I tried the below code but it gives non sensical results: 

model = inla(formula, data = Data, family = 'Poisson',
             control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE))

preds <- exp(model$summary.linear.predictor)

So what's the easiest way to calculate the posterior predictive distributions and extract their expectation after fitting the model? 

Thanks in advance,
Amin
